body.normal: A Limited Liability Partnership is incorporated through FiLLiP, the Ministry of Corporate Affairs form for LLPs. The name is reserved first (through RUN-LLP or inside FiLLiP), then FiLLiP is filed with the partners' details and registered office.
body.simple: An LLP is set up with one government form called FiLLiP, after its name is approved.
body.detail: LLP incorporation has three main moves. First the name is reserved, either with RUN-LLP or directly inside FiLLiP. Then FiLLiP is filed with the designated partners, their identity documents, the registered office and each partner's contribution. Once the Registrar approves it, a Certificate of Incorporation with an LLPIN is issued. The LLP agreement must then be filed in Form 3 within 30 days of incorporation.
body.why: An LLP follows a different path from a company, so the forms and timelines you see for your project differ from SPICe+.
